basics.name: Beatriz Carvalho Nogueira
basics.label: PhD Student in Informatics
basics.summary: I am a PhD Student in Informatics at FCUL/LASIGE in joint supervision with KTH Royal Institute of Technology, supported by a Mixed FCT Studentship. My research focuses on Human-Robot Interaction (HRI), HCI, and accessibility, specifically long-term trust calibration for older adults.

work.name: LASIGE - FCUL / FCiênciasID
work.summary: Working on EU Horizon project HARIA (Human-Robot Sensorimotor Augmentation) on HRI Failure Taxonomies and accessibility assessments for stroke and spinal cord injury end-users. Also contributing to project EXPRESS-AR.
highlights: HARIA: Wearable Sensorimotor Interfaces and Supernumerary Robotic Limbs
EXPRESS-AR: Artistic Expression for Tetraplegia using AR and Robotics
